messages:
matt (Revenue): Quick flag - pricing-experiment for Q2 (flex-hourly promo) looks like it caused recognized revenue to include trial hours that should have been billed-as-deferred credits. Found a block of customers where we recognized instead of deferring. Uploading sample invoice + experiment config to s3: s3://redwood-bills/experiments/flex-q2/sample.zip :file_folder:
julia (Billing Ops): Can you paste the invoice excerpt? Want to confirm whether the renderer added a negative 'promo token' line or if recognition logic pulled the gross amount.
matt (Revenue): Excerpt from customer ACCT-1298 invoice: ```
Service: Flex reserved hours (May 1-14) | Billed: $27,800.00
Promo applied (experimental credit) | -$5,450.00 | BUT credit was logged as post-bill adjustment, not a negative line on the invoice PDF
Net due: $22,350.00
```
nate (FP&A): The issue appears to be that credits were applied as AR adjustments after revenue recognition job ran for the period. Our close shows revenue = $27.8k for these accounts; true earned revenue for the period should be $22.35k because $5.45k is promotional usage that is deferred. Aggregate impact across sample set = $22,350. Materiality check: under $50k but it affects month-end.
emma (Controller): For items posted in the period that should have been deferred, standard handling is a prior-period adjusting journal to move the promo portion into deferred revenue. Provide GL mapping and attach experiment config + ticket.
matt (Revenue): Proposed JE to post in May period: debit 4001 Hosted Revenue $5,450.00; credit 2300 Deferred Revenue - promos $5,450.00. Memo: "Q2 flex-hourly promo misclassification - move promo to deferred revenue (experiment ID: EXP-Q2-FLEX)". We'll batch similar customers and post aggregate JE of $22,350.
julia (Billing Ops): I'll open a billing-engine ticket - looks like the promo pipeline set a post-bill adjustment flag instead of a negative invoice line for promo-type credits when experiment flag is active. That prevented correct revenue tagging.
rev-bot (revops-bot): New ticket created: BILL-9502  Promo credit applied as post-bill adjustment during EXP-Q2-FLEX. Link: https://tickets.internal/BILL-9502
nate (FP&A): Also recommend we adjust our deferred revenue schedule for the month and add a one-line note in the close pack describing the experiment impact and JE. I'll update the working papers.
emma (Controller): I approve the JE mapping for an aggregate prior-period adjustment < $50k. Please include supporting docs: sample invoices, experiment config, and ticket number. Post by EOD tomorrow so auditors see the adjustment in the open window.
matt (Revenue): Will prepare the JE bundle and attach all docs. Julia, please add a stopgap in billing: disable EXP-Q2-FLEX promo pipeline or force negative invoice lines until fix ships.
julia (Billing Ops): Putting a temporary toggle on the experiment and adding a validation to require invoice negative line creation for promo credit codes. Will add a changelog entry and estimate patch timeline: 2 business days.
rev-bot (revops-bot): Reminder scheduled: JE approval pending - NetSuite task 8123. Link: https://alerts.internal/journal/8123
matt (Revenue): Thanks all. I'll post the JE request and ping for sign-off. Closing note: if experiment rollouts create more than $50k of misclassifications, escalate to finance leadership and pause experiments until we have stronger revenue safeguards. :warning:
